updates.title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: FTP and SFTP Transfer Protection Now Available
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now supports monitoring and protecting sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols from managed endpoints. Admins can enforce restrictive actions on these file transfer methods to prevent unauthorized data exfiltration while maintaining visibility.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Expands to Microsoft Cowork
updates.summary: Data Loss Prevention policies now extend to Microsoft Cowork, allowing admins to apply consistent protection across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork environments. The integration supports blocking prompts containing sensitive information, restricting labeled knowledge sources, and preventing sensitive data from being sent to Bing for web search.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Restrict External Email Processing in Copilot
updates.summary: A new DLP control is coming that prevents Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from processing emails originating from external senders. This real-time safeguard helps organizations mitigate data exfiltration risks when employees use AI assistants on external communications.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Expanded Inline Protection for Unmanaged AI Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: DLP protection is expanding to cover a broader set of unmanaged generative AI applications within Edge for Business through inline policy controls. Admins can detect and protect sensitive data shared through supported browser activities using existing Purview policy tools.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Information Protection: Auto-Labeling for Legacy Office Formats
updates.summary: Server-side auto-labeling is expanding to support legacy Microsoft Office formats (.doc, .xls, .ppt), enabling automatic sensitivity label evaluation and application for these older file types in SharePoint and OneDrive. This improves governance over organizations still using or archiving legacy Office documents.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Version Trimming for Retained Files
updates.summary: A new policy-scoped setting will allow SharePoint and compliance admins to enable automatic trimming of file version bloat created by retention policies in OneDrive and SharePoint, while preserving legal-hold and records compliance. This helps large enterprises reclaim storage without breaking regulatory promises.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes (main and auxiliary) are now accessible through Microsoft Graph APIs, providing a unified view for users and admins before legacy EWS APIs are deprecated in October 2026. This ensures continued programmatic access to archive mailbox data for lifecycle management and compliance scenarios.
